data.label: Data
data.hint: Export your progress to a file to back it up or move it to another device. Import restores your own progress from such a file. Stays on your device — no account, no network.
data.exportError: Couldn't export your progress. Please try again.
data.confirmOverwrite: Restore will OVERWRITE your current progress on this device. This cannot be undone.
data.importInvalid: That file isn't a valid lingvago2 progress backup. Your current progress is unchanged.
data.importError: Couldn't import that file. Your current progress is unchanged.

reference.title: Reference
reference.intro: Quick grammar cards to re-read before a mock — articles & gender, prepositions, ser/estar, and verb endings.
reference.empty: No reference cards are available yet. They load with the app content.
reference.notFound: That reference card was not found.
reference.error: Couldn't load reference cards. Please try again.

today.label: Focus on today
today.body: One calm step at a time. Listen to live European Portuguese, write a short text, drill your weak groups, and run a mock when you're ready. No countdowns — just today's work.

checklist.label: Exam groups checklist
checklist.hint: Tick a group once you've prepared it.

mock.label: Mock results by group
mock.hint: Enter each group's score out of 50 after a paper mock run.

threshold.label: Pass thresholds
threshold.hint: Optional — ask your teacher. Leave blank to keep scores informational only.
threshold.totalAria: Total points required to pass, out of 200
threshold.minGroupAria: Minimum points required per group, out of 50

verdict.label: Verdict
verdict.riskDetail: At least one set threshold is not met yet.
verdict.noneDetail: Set at least one pass threshold to see a verdict. Until then, here are your raw scores by group.

warning.zeroGroup: Don't zero a group — a group at 0 needs attention even if your total looks fine.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.intro: Type the answer — both directions, cardinals and ordinals. A generative production drill (no multiple choice). Not gamified.

conjugation.title: Conjugation
conjugation.intro: Type the present-tense form — a single person, or assemble the whole table. A generative production drill (no multiple choice) over verified verbs only. Not gamified.

gender.title: Gender & articles
gender.intro: Pick or type the article — definite, indefinite, and contractions (do/da/no/na/ao/à). Production-first over verified nouns only. Not gamified.

preposition.title: Prepositions
preposition.intro: Fill the blank with the right preposition — time, place, and movement. Production-first cloze over verified examples only. Not gamified.

possessive.title: Possessives
possessive.intro: Read the person cue, then type the agreeing possessive — meu/minha, teu/tua, dele/dela. Production-first cloze over verified examples only. Not gamified.

interrogative.title: Question words
interrogative.intro: Read the meaning cue, then type the matching European-Portuguese question word — quem, onde, como, quando, porquê. Production-first cloze over verified examples only. Not gamified.

setup.label: Paper simulation · 90 minutes
setup.body: This is a 90-minute timed exam simulation. No hints and no instant grading: solve the real exam on paper or against the matrix while the clock runs. When you finish, manually enter your per-group score.
setup.hint: The app never grades the exam and never hints during the run.

entry.label: Enter your per-group score
entry.hint: Out of 50 per group — from your paper run.

review.label: Review
review.zeroWarning: Don't zero a group — a group at 0 needs attention even if the total looks fine.
review.saved: Result saved to your exam survival kit.
